title: Astrid and the Choir
author: Kestrel Thornbury
blurb: August Blackwood, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
